cases.title: Cargo vessel reports approach by small craft
cases.content: A cargo ship transiting the Bab-el-Mandeb strait reported being approached by two small skiffs late on Tuesday. The master increased speed and naval escorts intervened. No injuries were reported and the vessel continued its passage.

cases.title: Tanker damaged after explosion in the Gulf of Aden
cases.content: An explosion damaged the hull of a product tanker in the Gulf of Aden on Wednesday morning. Two crew members were injured and the vessel is taking on water. Meridian Shipping said the vessel is under escort to a nearby port.

cases.title: Naval escort activity recorded in the Red Sea
cases.content: A frigate assigned to Task Group Kestrel conducted escort operations in the Red Sea. No engagement was reported. The deployment was described as routine.

cases.title: Shelling reported near Kerch Strait
cases.content: Artillery shelling was reported overnight near the Kerch Strait. Local authorities said several buildings were damaged. Casualty figures could not be confirmed.

cases.title: Airstrike reported outside Damascus
cases.content: An airstrike struck a warehouse compound outside Damascus early on Friday. Emergency services said the site was largely empty at the time and no fatalities have been confirmed.

cases.title: Protest activity recorded in Beirut
cases.content: A demonstration over fuel prices took place in central Beirut. Organisers described the gathering as peaceful. Traffic was disrupted for several hours.

cases.title: Ransomware disrupts port operator systems
cases.content: A ransomware incident disrupted scheduling systems at Anatolia Port Services, which serves Istanbul. Container handling continued manually. The operator said no customer data appeared to have been accessed.

cases.title: New export controls announced
cases.content: A government announced fresh sanctions and export controls covering dual-use electronics. The measures take effect next month and affect several named intermediaries.

cases.title: Convoy movement observed near Odesa
cases.content: A convoy of military vehicles was observed moving overnight near Odesa. No engagement was reported. Analysts described the movement as a routine rotation.

cases.title: Wildfire spreads near populated area
cases.content: A wildfire spread rapidly across scrubland and forced the evacuation of a nearby settlement. Firefighting aircraft were deployed. No casualties have been reported.

cases.title: Explosive device detonates at checkpoint
cases.content: An improvised explosive device detonated at a roadside checkpoint near Mogadishu. Several people were killed and others were wounded. A security cordon remains in place.

cases.title: Port authority confirms berth closure
cases.content: A port authority confirmed that one berth will remain closed for maintenance for two weeks. Vessels are being redirected to adjacent terminals.
